title: billing / giftcard.issued (v1) data payload
description: Billing (stored-value ledger SoT) ISSUED a bearer gift card after a confirmed purchase (Round 17, ADR-0011). A gift card is an anonymous, transferable stored-value balance redeemed by code — it carries NO PII. Published to 'billing.events' with routing key 'giftcard.issued'; caused by a 'payment.captured' (purpose=giftcard_purchase). Consumed by Bar/POS (local redemption table), Frontend (show in account), Mailing (deliver the code to the recipient).

giftCardId.description: Stable id for the gift card in the ledger.

code.description: Bearer redemption code (the secret presented at redemption). No PII.

amount.description: Initial balance, currency MINOR units (integer cents). Non-taxable at issue (MPV).

expiresAt.description: Configurable expiry (RFC3339 UTC) with an EU-compliant minimum validity; null = no expiry.

sourcePaymentId.description: The payment.captured paymentId that funded this gift card (trace + idempotency).

at.description: When the gift card was issued (RFC3339 UTC).
